title: Introduce theme interpolation and Bento radius + spacing scale for responsive dashboards
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Define and deliver a cohesive token update that enables smooth theme interpolation between light/dark/alt themes and introduces a compact 'Bento' radius and proportional spacing scale for dashboard widgets and tables. This ticket covers color anchor interpolation rules, a 5-step proportional spacing scale, a Bento radius family (0/2/6/12), revised typographic rhythm for dense tables, and a motion-aware shadow prescriptive set for layered cards.

Background: Our current token set is static: separate palettes for light and dark with abrupt transitions and multiple bespoke radii used by different components. This causes visual inconsistency during theme switches and when components move between density contexts (expanded vs compact dashboard lanes). Engineering has requested deterministic interpolation rules to animate theme transitions, and platform customers have asked for a compact token set that preserves legibility in dense UIs.

Scope:
- Define color anchor tokens (surface-0..surface-4, accent-strong/neutral, support-success/warn/crit) with interpolation metadata (blend mode, linear vs perceptual).
- Create a 5-step proportional spacing scale: bento-0..bento-4 (4px, 8px, 16px, 24px, 40px) for use across grids, tables, and form controls.
- Introduce Bento radius family: bento-radius-0 (0px), bento-radius-1 (2px), bento-radius-2 (6px), bento-radius-3 (12px).
- Add motion-aware shadow presets (float, lift, inset) with tokenized elevation layers and a recommendation for animating shadow opacity/offset during hover/drag.
- Revise base typography rhythm for dense tables: compact-line-height tokens and responsive scale steps for 12/13/14/16pt contexts.
- Document migration guidance and automated codemod patterns for button, card, table, and chart components.

Out of scope: full color palette redesign of brand colors, platform feature changes beyond tokens, and backend-only runtime changes for KV cache.
tasks: Design: author token spec and usage examples (Figma file) — Maya
Engineering: draft CSS/JSON token schema and runtime interpolation hooks — request from Eng infra
Docs: update token reference and migration guide — product docs
Create codemods to replace legacy radii/spacing classes in component library
Validate accessibility contrast metrics for interpolated states
Create visual QA storybook pages demonstrating transitions and density toggles
acceptance_criteria: Token spec document (JSON schema) accepted by design and eng
Figma prototypes showing light↔dark interpolation with motion preserved
Automated tests that validate contrast ratios across interpolated midpoints
Component library updated: buttons, cards, tables, charts consume Bento tokens
Migration codemods with test runs on core repo and no visual regressions beyond approved diffs
Release notes and migration guide published in docs with examples
engineering_notes: Prefer Oklab for color interpolation where available; fall back to LAB where runtime lacks support
Expose interpolation metadata in token JSON: interpolation: 'oklab'|'lab' and blending: 'srgb'|'linear'
Runtime should offer a 0..1 transition multiplier to produce midpoints deterministically
Shadow animation guidance: vary opacity and y-offset, not blur radius, to avoid expensive re-rasterization on Chrome
Add feature flag 'tokens.bento_v1' for staged rollout on Dedicated and Private deployments
migration_notes: Codemod 1: replace radius-* with bento-radius-* mapping file included
Codemod 2: map spacing variables to bento- scale and flag components that rely on custom paddings
Charts: ensure color anchors map to series palettes; maintain legacy palette alias for backward compatibility
Provide a visual diff harness in PRs: snapshot tests + storybook screenshot comparison
rollout_plan: 1) Merge token spec and codemods behind feature flag. 2) Run codemods across component library and open PRs per package. 3) QA: design-led visual review + automated snapshot gating. 4) Gradual rollout to staging portals then prod with feature flag toggles. 5) Deprecate legacy tokens after two release cycles.
risks: Runtime lack of Oklab support could cause interpolation mismatches between browsers/apps
Large-scale codemods may surface regressions in third-party components using raw CSS values
Contrast failures at midpoints if interpolation function not perceptually uniform
Tight timeline could force design compromises leading to inconsistent density across surfaces
